recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the later FHIR-42886 model while repairing the seed-specific example references. Broader cleanup of unrelated stale Evidence example references should be handled under separate issue reconciliation.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 request to allow EvidenceVariable.characteristic.definitionReference to reference Group or EvidenceVariable, make definitionCanonical canonical(Any), update Evidence examples, and add Wardlaw2014Analysis1.16.3EvidenceSet plus Stroke_Thrombolysis_Trialists_2014-2016_IPD-MA_Cohort examples.
initial_application: The old source was changed by f9e5cb9d08: the spreadsheet definition[x] type became Reference(Group | EvidenceVariable) | canonical(Any), Evidence examples were updated, and the two EvidenceVariable examples were added. Subsequent refactors moved the source to StructureDefinition XML, and FHIR-42886 later removed characteristic and deleted the old examples.
additional_context: FHIR-42886 is a later Applied R6 decision, already present on the combined branch, that replaces EvidenceVariable.characteristic with EvidenceVariable.definition as CodeableReference and limits definition.reference to Group. Current source correctly follows that later model, so the old definitionReference/definitionCanonical changes should not be reintroduced. The remaining current-spec problem was the missing example targets referenced by active Evidence examples.
reconciliation: Added current-model EvidenceVariable examples for Wardlaw2014Analysis1.16.3EvidenceSet and Stroke-Thrombolysis-Trialists-2014-2016-IPD-MA-Cohort, and registered both in list-EvidenceVariable-examples.xml. The Wardlaw example uses definition.concept; the Stroke example uses definition.reference to the existing Group example.
